affectedPublicSurfaces: demo.app-juli.com replay run route — the Đề xuất stage, its confirm and decline controls (apps/demo)

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Load the candidate demo build — zero public canary traffic. The fix removes a network call from the replay path rather than adding one, so there is no API side effect in scope
candidateVerificationJourney.notes: Issue's own Release evidence section, transcribed verbatim; no additional surfaces inferred. Both defects are in code merged by #1752 (PR #1753) and both block gate #1322 observation 1.

journeys.name: replay-run-completes-by-confirming
assertions: Dùng thử Demo → approve → the Đề xuất stage is reached
the offer is NOT expired — its expiry is rebased relative to now, not the captured wall-clock time
the browser issues no /v1/* request for the whole journey

journeys.name: replay-run-completes-by-declining
assertions: declining renders the declined outcome as a choice, never an error
no /v1/* request is issued by the decline path either

journeys.name: signed-in-path-still-calls-the-real-endpoint
assertions: with a token present, confirming still POSTs to the real confirmations endpoint
the replay-local confirm handler does not shadow the signed-in path

staticAssetChecks.notes: No new assets. The existing captured scenario must still be present in the built artifact — verify-replay-scenario-in-build.mjs stays wired and passing.

migrationCompatibility.notes: Issue text: 'No migration.' Client-side rebasing and a local confirm handler in apps/demo.

rollbackAssertion.notes: Issue text: a rollback must not leave the replay door reachable with a confirm control that fires an unauthenticated request. The pre-change behaviour is the LESS safe one, so a rollback is a known regression to be recorded, not a neutral revert.

doNotInfer: release evidence fields beyond what the issue's Release evidence (ADR-035) section states
editing the captured scenario fixture to change expires_at — the fixture is byte-identical to the capture tool's output by acceptance criterion, and rebasing happens at read time, not in the file
an unauthenticated server replay endpoint — ADR-075 keeps every agent route authenticated and this path must call none
letting the replay-local confirm handler shadow or weaken the signed-in path's real POST
pinning or faking a clock in production source to hide the expiry — the rebasing must be real
widening the module-graph test's entry points without also making the assertion hold for them
